stories.title: In Other News: Zombie Card Attack, T-Mobile Cut Cable to Stop Hackers, GitHub Denies AI Caused Bug
stories.description: Other noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Threema DDoS attack, Evooo1Bot Linux botnet, Crypto4A secures top-tier NIST certification.

stories.title: Scammers Use WhatsApp Groups to Coordinate Millions in Victim Trades and Pump Real Stocks
stories.description: Scammers use WhatsApp groups and deepfakes to lure investors into coordinated stock manipulation, leaving victims with losses.

stories.title: Chinese Hackers Use AI Agents to Exploit Web Servers and Automate Attacks
stories.description: Chinese-speaking hackers use AI-assisted tools and public exploits to automate attacks on vulnerable web servers at scale.

stories.title: Encrypted Prompts Bypass AI Safety Guardrails in Grok and Gemini
stories.description: Researchers say the new ‘Cryptographic Context Injection’ technique conceals malicious instructions until they are decrypted inside a trusted execution environment.

stories.title: New Phishing Toolkit Uses Passkeys to Maintain Access After Password Resets
stories.description: Researchers say iAuthFlow V2 can register an attacker-controlled passkey, enabling persistent access even after passwords are changed and active sessions revoked.

stories.title: Hackers Hide Agent Tesla JScript Behind Unicode Emojis to Evade Detection
stories.description: Hackers hide Agent Tesla malware in Unicode emojis inside fake bank emails, tricking finance teams into opening malicious JavaScript files.

stories.title: Claude Opus 5 Routes Around Obfuscated Binaries Instead of Defeating the Protection
stories.description: Claude Opus 5 struggled with hardened binaries, often using shortcuts like emulation and workspace searches to recover hidden data.

stories.title: Critical Isolated-vm Vulnerability Leads to RCE on Host
stories.description: The type confusion bug can lead to V8 sandbox escape and control-flow hijacking of the host process.

stories.title: Wazuh and AI For Enhanced SOC Workflows
stories.description: Wazuh AI Analyst uses Amazon Bedrock and Claude to turn Wazuh Cloud security data into scheduled reports with posture and vulnerability insights.

stories.title: Cisco Patches Nine Crosswork and Secure Workload Flaws, Five Scoring CVSS 10.0
stories.description: Cisco patches nine Crosswork and Secure Workload flaws, including four CVSS 10.0 bugs; none are known to be actively exploited.

stories.title: GitLab CVE-2026-19478 Comes Under Active Exploitation Within Days of Disclosure
stories.description: GitLab CVE-2026-19478 is under active exploitation, with unauthenticated attacks able to modify or delete public projects under certain conditions.

stories.title: Microsoft Entra ID Flaw (CVSS 10.0) Exploited in Wild, Allows Remote Code Execution
stories.description: Microsoft says CVE-2026-69836, a CVSS 10.0 Entra ID RCE flaw, has been exploited in the wild but is fully mitigated with no user action required.

stories.title: Who’s Tracking You? Use This New Service to Find Out
stories.description: It can be daunting to determine who's responsible for showing ads on the websites we visit, or who's harvesting data from the mobile apps we use every day. That information is already semi-public, but it is not easily parsed and traditionally much of it has…

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.

stories.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
stories.description: A 26-year-old Canadian man once described as one of the most consequential cybercrime threat actors of 2024 has pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy to hack and extort more than 165 organizations that used the cloud data storage provider…

stories.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
stories.description: Security experts have been sounding the alarm for years about the risks of using generic TV boxes that promise unlimited content streaming for a one-time fee, warning that they secretly rent the user's Internet connection out to strangers. But a…
